hints.title: Right-to-Left Negabinary Addition
hints.text: Add bits from least significant to most significant with carry. In base -2, when sum s is partitioned, the digit is s & 1 and the new carry is -(s >> 1).

hints.title: Negative Carry Inversion
hints.text: Because the base is -2, division by -2 inverts the sign of the carry. For example, a sum of 2 yields digit 0 and carry -1.

hints.title: Leading Zero Truncation
hints.text: Continue while either array has digits or carry is non-zero. Reverse the collected bits and remove any leading zeros, keeping a single zero if the total is 0.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Converting negabinary arrays to big integers directly risks overflow and extra bigint conversion overhead.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Bit-by-bit addition with carry adjustment operates in linear time proportional to input array lengths.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should handle the -(s >> 1) carry formula and strip extra leading zeros.
complexity.notes: Carrying can briefly become negative or exceed 1 during intermediate steps.
